title: PM-KUSUM Scheme Commissioning Timeline Extended to March 31, 2027
summary: MNRE extends PM-KUSUM commissioning deadline to March 2027; committed liabilities to be subsumed under PM-KUSUM 2.0.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 PM-KUSUM Scheme Commissioning Timeline Extended to March 31, 2027. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: MNRE extended the commissioning timeline for **PM-KUSUM** solar pump projects (where PPAs/LoIs were signed by Dec 31, 2025) to **March 31, 2027**.
**PM KUSUM 2.0**: Proposed new framework to subsume committed liabilities of the ₹34,422 crore original scheme.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on nodal central ministry, total financial outlay, funding split ratio, beneficiary eligibility, and target milestone year.
